text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yaho, Espo-n. Accept my little bribe, 
please~.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? I don't need sleeves.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No, no. Today's Valentine's Day, right? 
So... here!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Damn it, that Tran... Shoving this onto 
me.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, what event is a better deal than 
Valentine's? Just giving something gets 
you back three times as much, right?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "I ain't givin' ya a payback like that."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Don't say that, just take it~. We're 
close enough to give each other friendship 
chocolates, aren't we?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
""...Besides, on a day meant for sharing 
your feelings, you might just be able to 
get it all out.""

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Welp! If you're ever in a pinch, don't 
forget to rely on your info broker!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ... ...What do you mean, 'rely on you'?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't you patronize me! Even if you act 
all soft like that...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ……! Like hell I could do that……!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While working in the trainer's office, 
Espoir City asked me for a certain favor.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You give it to Tran! Tell 'em I'm paying 
back what I owe!
choice_data_list:
Are you sure you don't need to return it 
in person?

Are you sure you don't need to return it 
in person?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I received gifts for her friends from 
Espoir City.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Tell 'em this too: ...I ain't such a soft 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...I'm a strong Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ended the conversation without prying 
any deeper. She probably didn't want to 
start a fight with the friend she was 
giving this gift to, either.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ... ...Hey, you.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (What do you think I should do?)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...It's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Apparently today's Valentine's Day. A day 
to express your feelings, or so they say.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: That kind of stuff... is so annoying.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "...I hate it. Right now, at least."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City stiffened her body 
defensively.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
... It doesn't really matter to me either 
way, though.
choice_data_list:
That's good to hear. Shall we head out for 
a bit?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I typed three words into the smartphone's 
search bar: "chocolate," "delicious," and 
"recommended."
choice_data_list:
I was just craving something sweet, you 
know.
I was just craving something sweet.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah... Dancing to their tune, aren't you? 
With those seasonal drinks.
choice_data_list: I hear it's supposed to be really tasty.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Phew, phew...
choice_data_list:
Why not take off the lid if you want it to 
cool down?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Wha—...! I was just about to do it!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...So swee——...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks for the food. It was decent 
enough."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Don't you go making the same face as 
Tran, too."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going home.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...My bad.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (...I know that.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(You guys aren't looking down on me. If I 
come to you for advice, you'll hear me 
out, right?)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: If I do that, then I'll……!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Hot chocolate filled with love! Delicious 
spell, make it sweet, kyun-kyun-kyun♡

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list:
N-No! It's just that people online said it 
was delicious!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Don't go denying it. If it's a 
hobby, just own up to it and say it's a 
hobby.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Good grief...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh!? It's delicious!?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, dear customer♡ We're so 
glad our feelings reached your heart♡

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now let's try it with each other, 
everyone~♡ Let's... Loooove♡

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
All together now! Become delicious, Kyun 
Kyun Kyun♡

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Kyu...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Like hell that's "so"!? No way! Like I'd 
ever do that!?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text: Eeeh... Are you sure~? Hmmm, well then~.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
I'll say the magic words, so please just 
pour all your feelings into it, Master♡

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Take advantage of Valentine's Day! Send 
those feelings straight to their heart! ♡

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Are you k-kidding—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
""...Besides, on a day meant for sharing 
your feelings, you might just be able to 
get it all out.""

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Here we go~ Ready, and! Delicious beam, 
activate! Kyun-kyun-kyun♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City pressed her lips together, 
staring intently at the heart she had made 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —What could she be thinking right now?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, thank you so much! Nice 
heart-throb~~! You really poured a lot of 
feelings into it, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I didn't put any into it.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't put anything into it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City won't tell me her true 
feelings with words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“...With upbeat BGM playing in the 
background, the hot chocolate we drank 
together tasted bittersweet, despite its 
sweetness.”
